props.title: Divine Beauty Artists: bridal hair and makeup in Colorado.
props.lede: Getting a bride, her bridesmaids and the moms ready on the same morning is a lot for one person. Divine Beauty Artists is a great choice when you need a whole team.

headingText.html: Christy Kaliana founded Divine Beauty, and she runs it today with her husband, Kemper. Their licensed and insured artists work in Colorado, Florida and Arizona, and the Colorado team is based around Denver.

props.title: Divine Beauty Artists at a glance

rows.text: They offer bridal hair and makeup, with trials, airbrush or conventional makeup, false lashes and clip-in extensions.
Their Colorado artists are based around Denver, and they work in Boulder, Breckenridge, Vail and across the state. On the wedding day, they come to you.
Christy has more than 20 years in the beauty industry, including time as a national CoverGirl makeup artist, and she’s worked with hundreds of celebrities and professional athletes.
Christy hand-picks and trains every artist, and they’ll match you with an artist based on the look you want.

props.html: Bridal hair and makeup in Denver and the mountains
Whether you want full glam or a more polished version of your everyday look, the team works from your ideas. It helps to send photos of looks you like, including the back of the hairstyle you want.
Their artists keep their kits full of long-wearing products, and they’re happy to use your own favorites if you ask.
Many of their stylists also do cuts, color and other kinds of extensions, if you’d like those, too.

Hair and makeup for the whole wedding party
For a bigger wedding party, they send more than one artist, so the bridesmaids, the moms and anyone else who wants hair and makeup can be ready together.
Trials happen at an artist’s studio or with a mobile artist, depending on who you’re matched with.
You can see more of their work in their portfolio and on their Colorado page. To check your date, reach out to Divine Beauty through their website.

props.title: Need live music for your wedding, too?
props.lede: From the ceremony to the dance floor, we book live music all over Colorado. Take a look at live music for your wedding, or just send us your date.
